ESCAPE_RULE: No ancestor namespace handles/capabilities or alternate launch channel; verify membership, inherited FDs and escape restrictions
IDENTITY_RULE: Bind host PID plus start identity and namespace identity; PID number alone unsafe
INDEPENDENT_SESSIONS: Must remain in verified PID namespace or dedicated kernel boundary; process group does not define coverage
KERNEL_LIFECYCLE_GUARANTEE: Candidate init-death teardown must be independently qualified for exact kernel/bwrap/runtime; no qualification from documentation or user success
MISSING: Exact qualified observer/init targeting and independently supported teardown/membership evidence
PARENT_FAILURE: Outside guard remains active; workload controller exit/hang does not disable deadline
TERMINATION_CANDIDATE: External observer identifies namespace init with stable process identity and forces init termination; separately observe supervisor and every known member exit and no remaining namespace members
UNKNOWN_DESCENDANT_POLICY: Unknown or surviving namespace member denies success; no retry
